conclusion: The v0.4 mission seed includes template_id. When template_id is omitted, the default identifier hashes the entire template_spec, including execution. A V06 profile with an explicit template_id keeps the mission seed stable under this execution-only edit.

method.environment: Conda llm, Python -B, code supplied on stdin; in-memory calculation only
method.hash: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False and allow_nan=False
method.large_integers: Seeds are decimal strings to preserve exact 64-bit values in JSON consumers.

interpretation.scene_sampling: The scene seed formula excludes template_id, so this edit does not itself change scene sampling or family geometry.
interpretation.current_planner: The v0.4 reconnaissance plan_routes implementation does not use TaskSpec.seed for random route choices. The consequence for v0.5 patrol sampling must be tested when that planner is implemented.
interpretation.r06_regression: With task_semantics_only_v1, an execution-only edit must leave the semantic identifier, mission seed and sampled patrol choices unchanged; a mission/planner semantic edit should change the semantic identifier and seed. Without seed_scheme, regenerate V06 and compare frozen artifact hashes.
